facts.text: Greensboro College waives course overload charges for honors students, permitting them to enroll in more than 18 credit hours per semester at no additional cost.

sources.title: Honors | Greensboro College
sources.quote: Honors students can overload their schedules beyond 18 credit hours at no additional cost. Greensboro College waives the usual overload charge for enrolling in more than 18 credit hours per semester.

facts.text: Greensboro College offers 42 undergraduate and six master's degree programs and hosts the Greensboro College Middle College and Governors School West.
